en: A monochrome historic postcard showing a street view with a substantial brick building on the left, likely a restaurant or inn, with several windows, dormers, and flagpoles. Attached or adjacent on the right is an ornate gateway-like structure covered with plants, referred to as a winter garden. Trees and a rural background appear on the right side of the image. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Hainichen in Saxony and labels the scene as the Wintergarten.
